title: Temporal Usage Patterns
insights:
Dataset Summary

Total Events: 14,952

Total Users: 381

Event Types: 109

Date Range: November 27, 2025 - February 22, 2026

Temporal Analysis Findings

Peak Hour: 9 AM

Off-Peak Hour: 9 PM

Peak Day: Saturday

Low Day: Wednesday

Peak-to-Trough Ratio: 336.8

Analysis

PUSH NOTIFICATION TIMING

The marketing team should send push notifications during peak hours to maximize open rates. The exact peak hour is:

  • 9 AM on Saturday

This is when user engagement is at its highest, ensuring that notifications reach the largest audience effectively.

CAPACITY PLANNING

The app needs maximum server capacity during peak usage times, specifically:

  • 9 AM on Saturdays

Given the peak-to-trough ratio of 336.8, infrastructure should be prepared for significant traffic spikes, particularly on weekends.

MARKETING WINDOWS

The best times for running in-app promotions or flash sales are during peak hours, particularly:

  • 9 AM on Saturdays

Utilizing this time for promotions can leverage the high user engagement, ensuring better visibility and participation in the campaigns.

WEEKEND VS WEEKDAY

Usage patterns indicate that the app is likely more focused on leisure travel rather than commuting. The peak day being Saturday suggests that users are engaging with the app for travel planning during their leisure time. Conversely, Wednesday shows the lowest engagement, indicating a potential lack of commuter usage on weekdays.
